entities.summary: The Mahkamah Mosque, also known as the Mosque of Birdibak or the Madrasa of Amir Bardabak was a Friday mosque and madrasa, that was located along Baghdad Street near the main western entrance of the Shuja'iyya district in Gaza City, in the State of Palestine.
